title: Gokarna Beach Trek from Bangalore (2026) – Itinerary, Price & Guide
metaDescription: Book Gokarna Beach Trek from Bangalore at ₹3,999. Trek 7 km across 5 beaches — Belekan to Om Beach. Camping, Jog Falls & Sharavati Backwaters all included.
highlights: — Belekan, Paradise, Half Moon, Om, and Kudle in one coastal route
Arabian Sea on one side, green coastal hills on the other
— rocky ridgelines and shaded forest paths between every beach
— twin-sharing tents near the sea with campfire under open sky
— mangrove channels and calm estuary on the Day 2 return

itinerary.title: Departure from Bengaluru to Gokarna Beach Trek Departure at 9:00 PM from Indiranagar.
itinerary.description: Please arrive at least 10 minutes early. Overnight journey along NH66 to the Karnataka coast. Your journey to Gokarna begins with an overnight departure from Bangalore. Board the vehicle from your selected pickup point and get ready for an exciting coastal experience. Pickup Points: Indiranagar 9:00 PM — Karachi Bakery Domlur 9:20 PM — Union Bank Yeshwantpur 10:30 PM — Metro Station Market Exit Gorguntepalya 10:45 PM — People Tree Hospital Have dinner before boarding. Non-AC vehicle with pushback seats. Overnight journey along NH66 — approximately 9 hours to the Karnataka coast.

itinerary.title: Gokarna Beach Trek – 5 Beaches | Trek Distance: 7 km Arrive at the campsite near Gokarna early in the morning.
itinerary.description: Check in, freshen up, and enjoy breakfast before heading to the trek starting point at Belekan Beach. The trail begins at the southern end of Belekan Beach and immediately enters coastal scrub forest. This first section is a short elevation gain through the treeline before descending to the most secluded beach on the route — Paradise Beach. Accessible only on foot, with no road access and no vendors, Paradise Beach is where the trek earns its reputation. From Paradise, the trail climbs a rocky coastal ridge before descending to Half Moon Beach — named for its distinctive crescent shape and one of the most photographed sections of the route. The final stretch follows the coast to Om Beach, the finishing point, shaped like the Om symbol and lined with cafés and shacks. Free time at Om Beach — swim, eat lunch at a café (self-sponsored), explore the beach, and take in the Arabian Sea before the group assembles for the return to camp. Evening at the campsite with bonfire, dinner, and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing and Return to Bangalore Morning breakfast at the campsite and checkout.
itinerary.description: Begin the return journey to Bangalore with two included stops along the way. The first stop is Sharavati Backwaters at Honnavar — a scenic boat ride through the Sharavati River estuary with calm mangrove channels and a quiet natural landscape completely different from the previous day's coastline. One of the most underrated experiences on this route. The second stop is Jog Falls — India's tallest plunge waterfall at 830 ft (253 m), with four distinct streams dropping off the edge of the Western Ghats plateau. The viewpoint gives a full frontal view of all four falls. Entry fee is self-sponsored. Self-sponsored dinner en route. Return drive to Bangalore with expected arrival around 4:00–5:00 AM. Drop points are the same as pickup locations in reverse order. Plan your next morning accordingly.

The Gokarna Beach Trek is not a resort beach holiday — it is an active coastal trail connecting five beaches on foot, with the Arabian Sea as your constant backdrop. The terrain shifts between flat sand, shaded forest paths, and short rocky ridge sections, and each beach has a completely different character. Expect a relaxed pace, genuinely beautiful coastal scenery, and the satisfaction of arriving at Paradise Beach knowing that the only way in was on foot.

One night in twin-sharing tents set up near the Gokarna coast. Tents are pitched on firm ground with basic facilities. It is proper camping — not glamping — with a campfire in the evening, the sound of the sea nearby, and a genuinely open-sky night. Sleeping bags and mats are arranged. This is the right way to sleep in Gokarna.
accommodations: Comfortable homestay accommodation on sharing basis.
teamNote: Our experienced trek leaders and local guides accompany you throughout the trek to ensure safety and a smooth experience.

faqs.question: What is the Gokarna Beach Trek?
faqs.answer: The Gokarna Beach Trek is a 7 km coastal trail in Karnataka that connects five beaches — Belekan, Paradise, Half Moon, Om, and Kudle — on foot. The trek also includes overnight coastal camping, boating at Sharavati Backwaters, and a visit to Jog Falls on Day 2.

faqs.question: How long is the Gokarna Beach Trek?
faqs.answer: The trek covers 7 km along the Karnataka coastline, completed in 5–6 hours including beach breaks and rest stops.

faqs.question: What is the difficulty level of Gokarna Beach Trek?
faqs.answer: Easy to Moderate. The trail has flat sandy sections, shaded forest paths, and short rocky ridge sections between beaches. No steep mountain climbs or technical skills required. Suitable for complete beginners.

faqs.question: What beaches are covered on the Gokarna Beach Trek?
faqs.answer: The trek covers five beaches — Belekan Beach (start), Paradise Beach, Half Moon Beach, Om Beach (end of trek), and Kudle Beach. Each has a distinct character and terrain section connecting it to the next.

faqs.question: What is the best time for the Gokarna Beach Trek?
faqs.answer: October to March is the best time. The weather is cool, the sea is calm and swimmable, and the coastal trail is in ideal condition. November and December offer the best overall experience.

faqs.question: Is the Gokarna Beach Trek safe for solo women travellers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every Gokarna batch includes certified female trek leads. The group operates with fixed safety protocols at all water points and rocky sections. Solo women travellers are welcome and common on this trek.

faqs.question: How far is Gokarna from Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Gokarna is approximately 487 km from Bangalore — around 9 hours by road via NH66. The package includes overnight transport both ways from four Bangalore pickup points.

faqs.question: What accommodation is provided on the Gokarna Beach Trek?
faqs.answer: One night of camping in twin-sharing tents set up near the Gokarna coast. Sleeping mats are provided. It is open camping — not glamping — with a campfire and coastal setting.

faqs.question: Is swimming allowed at the beaches on this trek?
faqs.answer: Yes. Free time is given at Om Beach specifically for swimming, relaxing at cafés, and exploring. Paradise Beach and Half Moon Beach are also swimmable but the group does not take extended breaks there. Always swim within safe zones and follow the trek lead's instructions near water. 10 What is Sharavati Backwaters and why is it included? Sharavati Backwaters is the estuary of the Sharavati River near Honnavar — a network of calm mangrove channels ideal for boating. It is a scenic and relaxing contrast to the previous day's coastal trek and is included as a boating activity on the return leg. 11 What is the height of Jog Falls? Jog Falls is 830 ft (253 m) tall — India's tallest plunge waterfall with four distinct streams: Raja, Rani, Rover, and Rocket. The entry fee to the viewpoint is self-sponsored. 12 Is there mobile network on the Gokarna Beach Trek? Mobile connectivity is generally available in Gokarna town and at Om Beach. On the trail between Belekan and Om Beach, especially at Paradise and Half Moon, network can be very limited. Inform family before departure and carry a power bank. 13 What should I carry for the Gokarna Beach Trek? Two pairs of footwear (trekking shoes and floaters), 2 litres of water, sunscreen SPF 50, poncho, quick-dry towel, swimwear, snacks, headlamp, power bank, valid photo ID, and cash for Om Beach lunch and Jog Falls entry. 14 What time does the group return to Bangalore? The group reaches Bangalore approximately at 4:00–5:00 AM on the morning after Day 2. Plan your next morning accordingly. 15 What is the entry fee and total cost for Gokarna Beach Trek from Bangalore? The Gokarna Beach Trek package with JungleTour is priced at ₹3,999 per person, inclusive of round-trip non-AC transport from Bangalore, overnight coastal camping, meals as per itinerary, Sharavati Backwaters boating, and a certified trek lead. The Jog Falls viewpoint entry fee (approximately ₹50–₹100) is self-sponsored and not included in the package price. Budget an additional ₹300–₹500 for Day 1 lunch at Om Beach, return journey meals, and personal shopping. There are no hidden charges — the full package breakdown is listed under inclusions on the JungleTour website.
